title: Day Zero POC Ops Checklist and Sprint Journal
content:
Purpose:
A compact, operational Day Zero playbook and sprint journal for the ‘LexiSearch’ customer POC (summary: document search + semantic reranking). Intended to be carried by the on-call solutions engineer during week-0 and used as a shared notebook during the workshop.

Quick goals (customer-aligned):
- Demo: sub-second snippet generation for top-3 search results on a 5M doc corpus (target median latency < 800ms for 512 token context).
- Cost: baseline run cost estimate for 1k qps sustained with caching and batching options.
- Integration: working ingestion pipeline (S3 -> Redwood ingestion lambda) and example client calls from customer dev env.
- Acceptance: 5 pre-specified queries produce acceptable relevance per customer rubric (see acceptance criteria below).

Scope / out-of-scope (week-0):
- IN SCOPE: dataset ingest + indexing stub, hosted inference routes configured, basic fine-tune/embedding run for 100k docs, end-to-end demo app for product manager.
- OUT OF SCOPE: full PII redaction automation, enterprise SSO setup, long-term SLA contract. Those are separate follow-ups.

Day Zero checklist (morning pre-workshop):
- [DONE] Confirm meeting invite and join links w/ customer (owner: Jordan Kim).
- [TODO] Validate customer dataset access (S3 creds scoped, owner: Priya Rao) — BLOCKED if cust IT firewall blocks outbound (see risk 1).
- [DONE] Spin up dedicated sandbox on dev namespace (namespace: se-poc-lexi-01). Instance: 2xA10G; config pinned to model: redwood-rlm-13b-8bit (config PR #87).
- [TODO] Preload sample index (first 50k docs) and sanity-check embeddings (owner: Liam).
- [DONE] Demo script rehearsed (speaker notes in confluence link).
- [TODO] Confirm telemetry/trace keys are injected (owner: Maya) and verify traces show up in Redwood Console.

Workshop agenda (2.5 hours):
1) 5m: quick intros and success criteria check (attendees + PM).
2) 15m: architecture walkthrough (ingest, indexing, model selection, routing).
3) 30m: data ingest live run (S3 -> ingest lambda -> index). Goal: show first 1k docs indexed.
4) 40m: live query demo + reranking options. Measure latency and token cost.
5) 20m: failure mode tabletop (what if batching spike / cache invalidation).
6) 20m: next steps, acceptance checklist, and owner assignments.

Sprint journal (day-by-day notes, rough and candid):
2026-03-01 09:12 Elena: morning note — customer provided partial S3 access; credentials rotated by cust IT unexpectedly, had to re-request full read role. Slack thread #solutions-poc-341.
2026-03-01 09:47 Jordan: spun up sandbox cluster; observed missing kernel for model variant on A10G image. Workaround: fallback to a generic kernel that increases latency ~12%. Logged JIRA SE-4321.
2026-03-01 10:30 Priya: ingestion lambda failed with OutOfMemory on first run (dataset has nested PDFs). Short-term fix: increase memory to 1.5GB and add streaming parser. TODO: add robust PDF flattening in pre-ingest.
2026-03-01 11:05 Liam: verified embedding quality on 500 sample docs; embeddings appear noisy for OCR-heavy pages. Action: mark those docs for exclusion from reranking demo; customer to supply cleaned exports.
2026-03-01 14:00 Workshop: demo OK for PM, they asked for token-cost per-query breakdown in follow-up.

Decision log (concise):
- D1 (2026-03-01): Use redwood-rlm-13b-8bit for demo instead of 70B variant due to capacity constraints on dedicated sandbox. Owner: Elena. Rationale: predictable latency for demo.
- D2 (2026-03-01): Use prefix KV cache on search route; TTL 10 minutes for reranking keys. Owner: Liam. Rationale: reduces token spend for repeat queries.
- D3 (2026-03-01): Defer PII redaction to a follow-up spike; not blocking acceptance. Owner: Priya.

Acceptance criteria (customer rubric):
- AC1: Median latency for demo queries < 800ms across 20 runs.
- AC2: Top-3 results judged relevant (>= 4/5) on 5 seed queries chosen by customer.
- AC3: Ingest pipeline can process 10k docs/hour without observed errors in sandbox.

Action item tracker (short, copyable):
- TASK-1: Customer to provide cleaned 50k export (owner: Customer Data Team, due: 2026-03-05) — linked JIRA POC-711.
- TASK-2: Implement streaming PDF preprocessor (owner: Priya Rao, due: 2026-03-04).
- TASK-3: Add telemetry dashboard for per-query token cost (owner: Maya Chen, due: 2026-03-06).
- TASK-4: Re-run latency bench w/ KV cache on/off and attach results to confluence page (owner: Liam, due: 2026-03-03).

Risks & Mitigations (quick):
- Risk 1: Customer network blocks egress for sandbox -> S3 (impact: high). Mitigation: arrange temporary VPN tunnel or ask customer to stage a signed URL bundle. Owner: Jordan.
- Risk 2: OCR/dirty docs produce noisy embeddings (impact: medium). Mitigation: prefilter and flag docs, run small TF-IDF baseline to backstop rerank. Owner: Liam.
- Risk 3: Kernel incompatibility on certain GPU types (impact: medium). Mitigation: maintain a fallback model variant and note perf delta in demo script. Owner: Elena.

Rollback & fallback playbook (if demo degraded):
- Immediate: switch routing policy to cheaper, smaller model (redwood-mini-7b) and reduce context window to 256 tokens.
- If indexing fails: revert to precomputed sample index and run demo from static dataset.

Notes to self / rough follow-ups (informal):
- Remember to capture the customer PM quote about the feature — good for case study if they go to Beta.
- Capture exact step-by-step commands used to increase lambda memory (put in ops snippets).
- Cross-link PR #87 (config) with confluence brief; reviewer: @arch-sig.

Next steps (by 2026-03-06):
- Finish TASK-2 and TASK-3; re-run bench and update confluence.
- Book technical deep-dive with customer's infra team (Jordan + Priya) to unblock S3 access.
- Draft a follow-up proposal for Dedicated capacity estimate and monthly commit (engineering + sales sync).

Appendix: quick command snippets and links:
- Ingest lambda deploy: aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name se-ingest-lexi --memory-size 1536
- Bench script: ./bench/query_runner --model redwood-rlm-13b-8bit --queries seed_queries.json --runs 20
- Confluence brief: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/POC+Brief+RK-241
- Slack thread: #solutions-poc-341

End of journal (working doc) — keep iterative notes here; merge into final POC wrap doc when acceptance ticks all AC items.
